comment: Accepted known failures of tests/python/fuzz/fuzz.py. Each entry names a ledger id that is OPEN in tests/python/regress/manifest.json and a predicate on the case record (see README.md). A record that matches is tagged with the id and does not fail --strict; an entry whose ledger id is no longer open makes --strict exit 2 (remove the entry when the bug is fixed). Only open ledger bugs belong here; new findings do not.

accepted.name: gpu_w_block_parity_or_full_space
accepted.why: parity / full-space runs put every point-group star through the isotypic W path, which has no device kernel; device='gpu' refuses the block

message.re: n_up -1 \(dim [0-9]+\) is an isotypic \(W\) block, which has no device kernel

accepted.name: gpu_w_block_fixed_n_up
accepted.why: at fixed n_up a star with irreps of dimension > 1 (or a declined group path) goes to the isotypic W path, which has no device kernel (the K1-sym-composition-02 claim); P6.3 retires the W path (d-dimensional group sectors) for every n_up, which removes these too

message.re: n_up [0-9]+ \(dim [0-9]+\) is an isotypic \(W\) block, which has no device kernel
